payload.expected_mechanism: A Writer-skill revision that (1) branches behavior on the request's task type: feature/maintenance -> enumerate every explicitly stated requirement and example as a checklist before editing, verify each item locally before finalizing; bugfix -> minimal-diff discipline, verify the reported fault is fixed and the visible suite passes, change nothing else; (2) on a failed retry pursues a different approach rather than a minor variation.
payload.hypothesis: v3r3 evidence shows a bidirectional effect of writer guidance: the same requirement-enumeration instruction class that rescued cases in earlier cycles (c8) produced an observed regression on the H0-resolved seaborn bugfix case in v3r3, so unscoped imperatives perturb already-working bugfix flows. All six v3r4 H0 failures (astropy, matplotlib, sympy, seaborn, pytest, sphinx) finished with real patches that pass visible tests but miss official acceptance. Hypothesis: TYPE-SCOPED guidance rescues part of the evolution set while keeping the regression set green — enumerate stated requirements with per-item local verification for feature/maintenance requests (astropy, sympy, sphinx), and add an explicit minimal-diff discipline for bugfix requests (fix the reported fault, change no other behavior, add no speculative hardening) so the bugfix-majority regression set (django, xarray, requests) and the feature regression case (sklearn) are not disturbed. A hypothesis from the evolution-failure projections, not causal truth.
validation_plan: Freeze the candidate through the governed request/Writer/check/commit path with the attribution bound.
Execute the evolution set (v3r4 H0 failures) under the frozen H1 with identical inputs.
Execute the complete regression set (all v3r4 H0-resolved cases) under the frozen H1; any regression rejects the candidate and triggers governed rollback.
